summary_en: Arealink to acquire all ordinary shares of Storage King (TSE Growth) at ¥1,340/share, minimum 1,291,700 shares (¥1.73B). Tender period 9 Jul–21 Aug 2026 (30 business days). Warrants at ¥550,000 (Series 1) and ¥350,000 (Series 2). Target board recommends acceptance. Purpose: complete subsidiary acquisition. Six major shareholders (38.22% stake) have agreed to tender.
title_en: Notice of commencement of tender offer for Storage King Co., Ltd. (Security Code: 2997)
translation_en_brief: Arealink Co., Ltd., listed on the TSE Standard Market, announced on 8 July 2026 that its board has decided to launch a tender offer for all ordinary shares and warrants of Storage King Co., Ltd. (TSE Growth, Code 2997). The offer price is ¥1,340 per ordinary share; Series 1 warrants are offered at ¥550,000 each and Series 2 warrants at ¥350,000 each. The tender period runs from 9 July to 21 August 2026 (30 business days). The minimum number of shares to be acquired is 1,291,700 (representing a projected 66.67% post-acquisition stake), with no upper limit. The stated purpose is to make Storage King a wholly-owned subsidiary of Arealink. As of the announcement date, Arealink holds no Storage King shares or warrants. Storage King's board has endorsed the offer and recommends shareholder participation. Six major shareholders collectively holding 740,500 shares (38.22% of the outstanding equity) have entered into subscription agreements to tender all their holdings.
